description: Approximate monthly cost of living for one person, in EUR, rounded to the nearest 10, worked out from two public sources: Numbeo's country estimate for a single person without rent (withoutRent), plus the average rent of a 1-bedroom apartment outside the city centre published by Wise (withRent adds it). Only these derived, rounded figures are published, never the sources' own numbers. Country averages hide large differences between cities. Estimates, not live data.
inflationNote: Each country's inflation is a long-run reference for each country's consumer prices: the inflation target its central bank publishes (the middle of a range), as of September 2026. Long-run forecasts such as the IMF World Economic Outlook's five-year projections mostly converge on these targets. Where a central bank has no numeric target, the figure is about the 2015–2024 average. Only used to turn growth before inflation into growth after inflation; the user can overwrite it.

conversion.note: Figures the sources reported in USD or GBP were converted to EUR at these fixed rates before rounding.
